correctness.rationale: Support reduction W=N+r-U exact; universal U≤4(n−4) for r≥2 proved by disjoint-pair four-cross-edge compensation and intersecting-family star/triangle cases. One support gives 2n−2. Difference (n−5)(n−8)/2 yields exhaustive r and equality classification. Reproducible exhaustive searches n=7..9 match complete counts.

evidence: Perfect Roman functions correspond to uniquely dominated zero labels; arXiv:2309.07018 §2.3 is explicitly compared.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The statement is equivalent to optimization over supports with exactly-one disjoint pair count U(F). Ordinary and total Roman graphs allow or demand other local patterns and do not force U(F); perfect dominating sets lack the 1/2 weight labeling. No discovered equivalent phase transition.

residual_risks: An equivalent independently derived perfect Roman Kneser formula in older unindexed literature may exist.
General graph feasibility characterizations could permit a short alternate derivation, but do not themselves supply the exact extremal classification.
No claim beyond k=2 or n≥7; independent scientific validation not performed.
